title: Removing the positive tail of a bounded projective complex
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category and $L$ a cochain complex indexed by $\mathbb Z$. Assume there are integers $a,b$ with $L^j=0$ for $j<a$ or $b<j$, every $L^j$ is projective, and $H^j(L)=0$ for $j>0$. There exist a cochain complex $Q$ and an integer $a_0$ such that $Q^j=0$ for $j<a_0$, every $Q^j$ is projective, $Q^j=0$ for $j>0$, and for every integer $j$ there is an isomorphism $H^j(Q)\cong H^j(L)$. All categorical notions are those of Mathlib; no scheme or specified degree-zero module is assumed.

proof.text: The proved private helper projective_cycles uses induction on a natural-number distance to an upper bound. For j at least zero, the base case identifies cycles in degree j with L.X j because L.X (j+1) is zero. At the inductive step use positive homology vanishing in degree j+1 and Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.epi_toCycles to make L.X j to cycles(j+1) epic. Split this map by Projective.factorThru. The endomorphism 1-fs factors through cycles(j) by liftCycles, and its composite with the cycle inclusion is the identity. Hence cycles(j) is a retract of L.X j and is projective by Retract.projective. Instantiate at j=0 and n=b.toNat.

Construct Q as the good truncation L.truncLE along ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntLE 0. In negative degrees its terms are isomorphic to those of L; the boundary term at zero is isomorphic to cycles(0); terms in positive degrees are zero. These Mathlib comparison isomorphisms and the first step prove termwise projectivity. The same negative-degree term comparison transports the lower bound min(a,0).

Positive homology vanishing gives L.IsSupported for the embedding. Mathlib quasiIso_ιTruncLE_iff_isSupported proves that the truncation inclusion is a quasi-isomorphism. Use isoOfQuasiIsoAt in each integer degree for the final homology isomorphisms. All steps, including descending induction and construction of the retractions and Q, are proved in the delivered Lean module.

theorem boundedProjective_nonpositiveModel
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (L : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (hbound : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < a ∨ b < j → IsZero (L.X j))
    (hproj : ∀ j : ℤ, Projective (L.X j))
    (hexact : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j → IsZero (L.homology j)) :
    ∃ Q : CochainComplex C ℤ, ∃ a : ℤ,
      (∀ j : ℤ, j < a → IsZero (Q.X j)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, Projective (Q.X j)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j → IsZero (Q.X j)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, Nonempty (Q.homology j ≅ L.homology j))
